plugins.name: Data Viz
plugins.description: Design guidance for charts, graphs, dashboards, and data visualizations in any output medium — HTML artifacts, SVG, plotting libraries, or images. Produces consistent, accessible, brand-neutral visuals with a runnable color validator.

install.notes: Bundled with Claude Code. Invoke with the `dataviz` skill or trigger keywords: 'chart', 'graph', 'dashboard', 'data viz'.

plugins.name: Code Review
plugins.description: Review the current diff or a PR for correctness bugs, reuse/simplification cleanups, and efficiency improvements. Supports effort levels (low → max) and an ultra multi-agent cloud review mode. Can post findings as inline PR comments or apply fixes directly.

install.notes: Bundled with Claude Code. Use `/code-review` or `/code-review ultra <PR#>`.

plugins.name: GitHub MCP Server
plugins.description: Official GitHub MCP server. Search code, manage issues and PRs, create branches, push files, and trigger CI — all from within Claude. The most widely used MCP server for developer workflows.

install.notes: Requires a GitHub personal access token set as `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`. Add to your MCP config in Claude Code settings.

plugins.name: Filesystem MCP Server
plugins.description: Read and write files anywhere on your local machine via MCP. Useful for giving Claude access to directories outside the current workspace — a downloads folder, a shared drive mount, or a config directory.

install.notes: Pass one or more allowed root directories as arguments. Claude can only read/write within those roots.

plugins.name: Security Vulnerability Sweep
plugins.description: Scans the codebase for OWASP top-10 and common security vulnerabilities — injection, XSS, SSRF, broken auth, insecure deserialization, and more. Reports findings with severity and remediation steps.

install.notes: Bundled with Claude Code. Use the `security-vuln-sweep` skill.

plugins.name: Commit, Push & PR
plugins.description: One command to stage, commit with a generated message, push to remote, and open a pull request. Respects branch naming conventions, writes a structured PR description, and handles the common commit → PR workflow without leaving the chat.

install.notes: Bundled with Claude Code. Use the `commit-commands:commit-push-pr` skill.

plugins.name: Flow Sim
plugins.description: Turns a user flow spanning several services or repositories into an animated, self-contained HTML page showing who taps what, which service calls which, what is written or queued, and what returns by webhook or callback. Every hop is backed by a file, line, and commit, or drawn as unverified with an open question.

install.notes: Clone morning-song/setlist and copy skills/flow-sim/ into your project's .claude/skills/ directory. Requires Node 18+.

plugins.name: Engineering Standup
plugins.description: Generates a structured standup update from your recent git activity, open PRs, and in-progress work. Formats it for Slack or your team's standup format — yesterday, today, blockers.

install.notes: Bundled with Claude Code. Use the `engineering:standup` skill.
